description: Hi! I am a student who is passionate about space, science, and technology. I am eager to learn new things, explore creative ideas, and work with others to solve problems. I enjoy teamwork and sharing ideas. I am looking for motivated and friendly teammates who are interested in space exploration, innovation, and making a positive impact. Let’s learn, create, and achieve something amazing together!
summary:
Project VeyloraVN addresses the hidden legacy of space exploration—the silent rovers, landers, and technical remnants left behind on celestial bodies like Mars. While history celebrates milestone landings, hundreds of metric tons of historic hardware slowly fade under layers of cosmic dust.

To tackle this challenge, we developed an interactive digital archive and museum concept that maps, preserves, and honors these abandoned missions using authentic NASA data. This project is important because it bridges science and human empathy, ensuring that the trailblazing machines which paved our way into the cosmos are never forgotten.
details:
• What it does & How it works: It showcases the journey, coordinates, and physical footprints of historical rovers and landers left behind on celestial bodies like Mars (such as Perseverance). Through a 7-slide interactive presentation and digital curation, it transforms raw NASA data and imagery into a narrative about cosmic preservation.
  • Benefits & Impact: It bridges scientific exploration with human empathy, reminding audiences of the silent pioneers that paved the way for modern space travel.
  • Tools & Technologies: Developed using Canva for visual design, paired with official NASA open data and imaging resources for accurate mapping and telemetry.
  • Creativity: Instead of a dry technical report, the project approaches space history from a unique, empathetic perspective—telling the story from the viewpoint of the planet itself observing its mechanical visitors.
